input.quote: 7. LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR.
input.rationale: Despite the Section 7 heading referring to "INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR", the Agreement contains no operative indemnity language at all: Section 7 contains only liability caps, a consequential-damages waiver and an attorneys'-fees waiver, and searches for "indemnif"/"hold harmless"/"defend"/third-party claim return nothing else. Section 5(c) gives only a non-infringement warranty, which does not fund the defence or damages of a third-party IP claim. That leaves us with no Vendor IP indemnity, which is walk-away territory under this rule. We therefore added our fallback: a Contractor IP indemnity in new Section 7(d) with the customary Company-modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace remedies with a fee refund if none is available, and a super-cap of three times annual fees; the Section 7(a) cap is conformed so it does not swallow the new indemnity. No Company indemnity exists, so nothing needed narrowing (preferred-level items such as defence of affiliates, misconduct and data-breach coverage and claim procedure were not pursued at this fallback target).

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.

We also conformed the Section 7(a) cap so the indemnity is not swallowed by it.

ops.text: (d) Contractor shall indemnify Company against any third-party claim that the Services or Works infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from Company's modification of the Services or Works, from combination of the Services or Works with items not supplied by Contractor, or from Company's written specifications. For any such claim, Contractor shall procure for Company the right to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, and if none of those remedies is commercially available, Contractor shall refund the fees paid for the affected item. Contractor's aggregate liability under this Paragraph 7(d) shall not exceed three times (3x) the annual fees paid to Contractor under this Agreement.
